description_en: Rebuilds a secondary instance in a dedicated cluster by calling the RebuildDBInstance operation
description_zh: 调用RebuildDBInstance接口重建专属集群中的RDS备实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds rebuild-db-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-group-id dhg-4nxxxxxxx --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk5xxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: RebuildDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The dedicated cluster ID. You can call DescribeDedicatedHostGroups to query the dedicated cluster ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID in the dedicated cluster
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host on which the secondary instance is to be rebuilt.
If you do not specify this parameter, the secondary instance is preferentially rebuilt on the original host. If the original host does not have sufficient space, the system selects a host that does not contain the primary instance. If no host with sufficient space is found, an insufficient space error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
需要重建备实例的主机ID。
不传入该参数时，备实例会优先在原主机上重建，如果原主机空间不足，系统会选择非主实例所在的主机，若还是找不到足够空间，会返回空间不足错误
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of secondary instance to rebuild. Valid values:
FOLLOWER: secondary node.
LOG: log node
parameters.help_zh:
需要重建的备实例类型。取值：
FOLLOWER：备节点。
LOG：日志节点
parameters.name: rebuild_node_type

MigrationId.description_en: The queue number for the rebuild. When the number is 0, the rebuild migration starts
MigrationId.description_zh: 重建排队序号。当序号为0时，就会进行重建迁移
